removedAmbiguous.reason: Crabs are visible, but diagnostic species markings are not resolved; only one generic crab anchor is retained.
Many crabs are visible; repeated individuals are intentionally not used to inflate vocabulary.
Shell fragments are too small for taxonomic identification and are represented once as a generic fragment field.
Dense emergent stems are represented by structural plant terms rather than repeated individual anchors.
A single static image cannot establish tidal stage.
Visible channels do not establish the direction of flow.
Salinity is not visually observable.
Relative shallows are visible, but numerical or categorical depth cannot be determined reliably.
No nest structure can be isolated confidently among plant tussocks.
Dark underwater forms are rocks and shadows; no fish body is resolved.
The gray jetty unit could be a small motor or monitoring device; its identity is ambiguous.
Equipment is present, but no active sampling action is depicted.
Leaf and seed-head detail is insufficient for a species-level label.
Algal forms are visible but not diagnostic to species.
Small holes and depressions may be natural surface texture rather than burrows.
